title: Steampunk Time Fairy
description: A female steampunk fairy with mechanical wings, goggles, and segmented blue metal tail stands in the foreground, manipulating a beam of golden light. Behind her rises a surreal melting clock tower covered in dripping clocks and jellyfish-like creatures against a swirling pink and green sky.
prompt: A detailed surreal fantasy scene of a steampunk fairy with large pink mechanical wings, curly hair, and brass goggles, wearing a pink and green bodysuit with blue segmented mechanical tail. She stands beside a crumbling brick clock tower with melting clocks and glowing jellyfish creatures floating around. She is emitting a beam of golden light from her hands. The background features rolling hills, pink flowers, and a swirling pink and green sky with stars.
